name: A360 Insights – ChatGPT & AI Traffic Analytics for WordPress
author: team A360

sections.description:
A360 Insights helps you track ChatGPT traffic and AI referrals directly inside WordPress.

See which pages get visitors from ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, Claude, OpenAI and other AI discovery platforms without digging through complex analytics reports.

AI assistants are becoming a new discovery channel. If people find your content through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Claude, A360 Insights helps you see those visits in your WordPress dashboard.

A360 Insights also shows search traffic, referrals, campaigns, landing pages, channel types, engagement events and privacy-friendly visitor technology breakdowns.

No cookies. No IP tracking. No full user-agent storage. No external analytics account required. Your analytics data stays inside your own WordPress database.

Use A360 Insights when you want a lightweight, WordPress-native way to understand AI traffic, search traffic, referrers and landing page performance.

Watch the quick demo

Why use A360 Insights?

  • Find out whether ChatGPT sends visitors to your WordPress site
  • See which posts and pages receive traffic from AI assistants
  • Compare AI traffic with search, referrals, campaigns and direct visits
  • Identify landing pages that start valuable sessions
  • Track engagement events such as scroll depth, outbound clicks, downloads, phone clicks, email clicks and form activity
  • Keep analytics data inside your own WordPress database
  • Avoid cookies, IP storage and external analytics accounts

Features

  • Track Gemini traffic
  • Track Copilot traffic
  • Track Perplexity and Claude traffic

  • See AI Traffic Share

  • Click overview KPI cards to inspect focused chart breakdowns for AI Traffic, Search Traffic, Referrals, Sessions, Engaged sessions and Conversions

  • Landing page funnel reporting by anonymous sessions

  • Dedicated Landing Pages report with top source, engagement rate and conversion rate
  • Select business landing pages and filter reports to selected landing pages only

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/a360-insights/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to A360 Insights → Settings
  4. Choose what content should be tracked
  5. Open Posts / Pages and click the Views counter
sections.faq:
How do I show a public view counter?

Go to A360 Insights → Settings → Tracking → Public view counter and enable the footer counter. It is disabled by default.

You can show total site sessions, total site views, current content sessions or current content views.

You can also place the counter manually with [a360_views_counter scope="site" metric="sessions"] or [a360_views_counter scope="content" metric="views"].

Shortcode colors can be customized, for example [a360_views_counter scope="content" metric="sessions" icon_color="#2563eb" background_color="#ffffff" border="visible"].

Use background="transparent" for a transparent counter background.

Can I track ChatGPT traffic in WordPress?

Yes. A360 Insights detects traffic from ChatGPT and other AI assistants, then shows AI traffic directly inside your WordPress dashboard.

Which AI traffic sources are supported?

A360 Insights can classify traffic from AI and discovery platforms such as ChatGPT, OpenAI, Codex, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Perplexity, Meta AI, Mistral, You.com, Poe, Phind, DeepSeek and Grok.

Is this a Google Analytics alternative?

A360 Insights is a lightweight WordPress analytics plugin focused on AI traffic, referrers, search traffic, campaigns and content performance.
It is not intended to replace every advanced Google Analytics report, but it gives website owners a simple way to see important traffic data directly inside WordPress.

Does this show AI referrals and AI Traffic Share?

Yes. The dashboard includes AI Traffic, AI Traffic Share, Top AI Sources and source-level statistics.

Can I see which landing pages start sessions?

Yes. The dashboard includes Top Landing Pages based on anonymous sessions, with session counts and conversion rate for the selected period.

How do engagement events work?

Engagement events are tracked automatically on pages where A360 Insights is active:

  • Outbound clicks count clicks on links that lead to a different domain.
  • File downloads count clicks on downloadable files such as PDF, DOC, XLS, PPT, CSV, ZIP, images, audio and video files.
  • Phone clicks count clicks on tel: links.
  • Email clicks count clicks on mailto: links.
  • Form starts count the first interaction with a form field.
  • Form submits count submitted forms.
  • Scroll events count 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% scroll depth.

The percentage shown next to each engagement event compares that event count with page views for the selected period. For example, 10 phone clicks from 100 page views shows 10%.

Does this use cookies?

No. A360 Insights does not use cookies.

Does this track IP addresses?

No. IP addresses are never stored.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin is designed with privacy-first principles and avoids storing personal identifiers.
Website owners remain responsible for their own legal compliance.

Can I track UTM campaigns?

Yes. UTM source, medium and campaign parameters can be tracked.

Can I export analytics?

Yes. CSV export is included.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes.

Can I exclude administrators?

Yes.
